summary: Automation hub has staging repositories (label pipeline=staging; anyone who can upload to a namespace publishes there, content is hidden from search and shown on the approval dashboard) and custom repositories (write permission needed, public or private, not on the approval dashboard, searchable if enabled); uploads without a repository go to the default staging repo.
questions: What is the difference between staging and custom repositories in automation hub?
Why is my uploaded collection not in search results?
Where do collections go if no repository is specified?
What does the pipeline=staging label mean?
